label: Interhour of the Ninth Hour
description: The Interhour of the Ninth Hour (Mezhduchasiye) is a brief interstitial office appended to its Hour in monastic practice. CORRECTED 2026-09-26, Horologion audit fix pass (Findings IH1-IH3): the psalms were wrong, the troparia were wrongly modeled as Menaion-dependent (this office's troparia are a fixed, hour-specific triad per UNABHOR1997), and roughly half of the office's real closing content was missing outright. Rebuilt against UNABHOR1997 (Rassaphor-monk Laurence, The Unabbreviated Horologion, Holy Trinity Monastery, 1997) in full.
